id: 22_Stay Safe In The Lab Prevent Fires, Slips, And Falls! Training Course
title: 实验室安全：预防火灾、滑倒与跌落
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/22_Stay Safe In The Lab Prevent Fires, Slips, And Falls! Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/22_Stay Safe In The Lab Prevent Fires, Slips, And Falls! Training Course/src.py

points.K5: 火大或没把握，马上呼救
points.K9: 腰颈手腕疼，别不当回事
points.K10: 停、伸展、调工位，反复疼就医

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室里，身后墙上有灭火器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a lab with a fire extinguisher on the wall behind and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：防火灾、防滑倒、防劳损。

shots.scene: 阿杰端着烧杯快步走，地上有一摊水，台上加热套里的烧瓶在加热
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks fast holding a beaker toward a puddle on the floor, while a flask heats in a heating mantle on the bench.
shots.narration: 实验室里，火和滑倒随时可能发生。

shots.scene: 火焰、滑倒的小人、捶腰的小人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a flame, a person slipping on a wet floor, and a person holding an aching back. No people.
shots.narration: 物理事故包括火灾、滑倒摔倒和劳损。

shots.scene: 浓烟烈火，小研挥手让大家出去
shots.prompt_en: Thick smoke and flames rise; the female graduate student waves everyone toward the exit.
shots.narration: 起火了，先让所有人出去，别犹豫。

shots.scene: 人都撤出后，老李拿起灭火器面对一小团火
shots.prompt_en: With the area clear, the facility engineer grabs a fire extinguisher and faces a small fire.
shots.narration: 人撤清了，如果是小火，拿灭火器，

shots.scene: 四步图示：拔销、瞄准、压把、扫射
shots.prompt_en: Four-step diagram of using an extinguisher: pull the pin, aim the nozzle, squeeze the handle, sweep side to side. No people.
shots.narration: 按四步：拔销、瞄准、压把、扫射。

shots.scene: 大火全屏，欣欣身旁浮现四个火灾类别图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four fire class icons: burning paper, a liquid drop, an electric plug and a metal block.
shots.narration: 火灾分不同类型。

shots.scene: 燃烧的书页
shots.prompt_en: Burning book pages curling in flame. No people.
shots.narration: A类，纸、木材等普通可燃物。

shots.scene: 一排红色液化气罐图标，旁边燃烧的液体
shots.prompt_en: A row of red gas canisters beside a burning liquid spill. No people.
shots.narration: B类，易燃液体。

shots.scene: 燃烧的木炭，旁边插头闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Glowing burning charcoal beside an electric plug icon with a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: C类，电气火灾。

shots.scene: 燃烧的金属块图标
shots.prompt_en: A burning metal block icon with bright white flames. No people.
shots.narration: D类，金属火灾。

shots.scene: 灭火器标签类别和火灾类型用箭头对上
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher with a blank label showing class icons, matched by arrows to fire type icons. No people.
shots.narration: 一定要按火灾类型选对灭火器。

shots.section_title: 火大或没把握，马上呼救
shots.scene: 两人在烟雾中互相搀扶撤出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the older man support each other as they move out through smoke.
shots.narration: 火势失控或拿不准，别冒险，
overlay: 火大或没把握，马上呼救

shots.section_title: 火大或没把握，马上呼救
shots.scene: 电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 马上呼救。

shots.scene: 火灭后，老李检查余烬
shots.prompt_en: After the fire is out, the facility engineer checks the area for hot spots.
shots.narration: 扑灭后，再检查一遍，确认不会复燃。

shots.scene: 阿杰滑倒坐在地上，旁边有电线和安全帽
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has slipped and sits on the floor near a trailing cable and a hard hat.
shots.narration: 滑倒说来就来。摔了别马上跳起来。

shots.scene: 阿杰停下，扶着膝盖检查
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pauses, holding his knee and checking himself.
shots.narration: 先停一下，看看自己有没有事。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手求助，小研赶来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand for help and the female graduate student hurries over.
shots.narration: 哪儿疼或不舒服，就找人帮忙。

shots.scene: 阿杰扶着实验台慢慢站起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds the edge of a sturdy bench and stands up slowly.
shots.narration: 没事，再借助支撑慢慢站起来。

shots.scene: 平板拖把拖干地面
shots.prompt_en: A flat mop wipes the floor dry. No people.
shots.narration: 然后清理导致摔倒的东西，别人不再摔。

shots.section_title: 腰颈手腕疼，别不当回事
shots.scene: 老周双手捶腰；阿杰揉手腕
shots.prompt_en: The older man presses both hands against his lower back; the young male student rubs his wrist.
shots.narration: 劳损是重复工作后悄悄来的疼痛。
overlay: 腰颈手腕疼，别不当回事

shots.section_title: 腰颈手腕疼，别不当回事
shots.scene: 腰、颈、手腕三个红点的人体图标
shots.prompt_en: A body outline icon with red marks on the back, neck and wrist. No people.
shots.narration: 腰也好，颈也好，手腕也好，别不当回事。

shots.section_title: 停、伸展、调工位，反复疼就医
shots.scene: 小研戴口罩发帽，伸展颈部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a mask and hair cap stretches her neck.
shots.narration: 停下、伸展、调整工位。
overlay: 停、伸展、调工位，反复疼就医

shots.section_title: 停、伸展、调工位，反复疼就医
shots.scene: 小研向老周反映；理疗室里医生给她按肩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student talks to the older man about changes, then a doctor treats her shoulder in a therapy room.
shots.narration: 反复疼就提出改进，早点看医生。

shots.scene: 老李拿记录板站在药品柜前，旁边空白标准书有火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a clipboard in front of a chemical cabinet, next to a blank standard book with a flame icon.
shots.narration: 实验室防火，以美国消防协会45号为准。

shots.scene: 加热套上的圆底烧瓶，旁边城市消防规范本
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask in a heating mantle, beside a blank local fire code booklet with a city icon. No people.
shots.narration: 当地消防规范也同样重要。

shots.scene: 抄近路的箭头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A shortcut arrow crossed out with a red X next to a fire icon. No people.
shots.narration: 在这上面偷工减料，不值得。

shots.scene: 空白法规册，封面有星条旗图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank regulation booklet with a stars-and-stripes flag icon on its cover, beside an ergonomic chair icon. No people.
shots.narration: 人体工效，有美国职业安全卫生法规。

shots.scene: 疏散平面图背景前，两个条款编号图标
shots.prompt_en: An evacuation floor plan in the background with two blank regulation tag icons. No people.
shots.narration: 还有实验室安全和应急预案的条款。

shots.scene: 穿实验服的王老师在记录板上写字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator in a lab coat writes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 熟悉这些，就能安全又合规。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现撤离、灭火器、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an evacuation arrow, a fire extinguisher and a telephone.
shots.narration: 先撤人，小火按四步扑，火大就呼救。

shots.scene: 摔倒后慢慢站起和拖把图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person standing up slowly with support and a mop. No people.
shots.narration: 摔了先自查，慢慢起，清隐患。

shots.scene: 伸展的小人和法规册图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person stretching and a regulation booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 疼了伸展调工位，标准法规要熟悉。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the lab doorway.
shots.narration: 防火防滑防劳损，下次见！
